plain: The United States is said to have a secret office for spying under the sea, called the National Underwater Reconnaissance Office, or NURO. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says it was set up in 1969 and has still never been officially disclosed. Jesse Michels mentions it twice. Once he calls it the underwater "little brother" of the National Reconnaissance Office, the US spy agency for reconnaissance, and says it is now public but little is known about it. The other time he credits a man named Bob Ballard with founding it, and he gives no founding date either time. If true, it would mean the government quietly set up a programme to watch the oceans decades ago.
